name: Triple systems on 16 points without the complete 3-partite K(2,2,2)
description: construct() -> list of distinct triples [a, b, c] of distinct points in 0..15 such that no three disjoint pairs have all eight transversal triples present. Maximize the number of triples. A valid triple system with m triples certifies ex_3(16,K(2,2,2)) >= m; no finite value is documented.

sources.locator: Paul Erdős, On extremal problems of graphs and generalized graphs (1964). A valid triple system with m triples certifies ex_3(16,K(2,2,2)) >= m; no finite value is documented.
